name: How long does it take to install a basement door frame?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install a basement door frame?

acceptedAnswer.text: Installing a standard pre-hung interior door frame in a framed basement opening usually takes two to four hours. However, if the project involves building a new rough opening against concrete, anchoring pressure-treated sill plates, or custom finish trim, it can take a full day. Additional time is needed if drywall patching, mudding, and painting are part of the scope. When finishing a full basement living area, door frames are typically hung after drywall taping and mud are dry, but right before baseboards and casing are nailed in place.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installing a basement door frame takes about two to four hours for a standard pre-hung unit, or a full working day if new rough framing and custom trim work are needed.
